reviews.text: Lovely food (I felt like back home for a bit) and great service from the two girls that serves us ( a girl from Argentina and a chilean gal). We liked the steak sandwich so much that we came back for dinner before we left Christchurch

We visted the city as part of our international cruise and we ate at El Quincho. The food is so good. Love the sauce or chimichurri over the flame grilled meat. The perfect place for delicious food and wine at a resanoble price. Thank you.
If you happen to be on death row and need a recommendation for your last meal - The flank steak burger and fries El Quincho.
Amazing food and great service. Will definitely be returning
